# iosxe_sip_ua (Resource)

This resource can manage the SIP UA configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_sip_ua" "example" {
  transport_udp               = true
  transport_tcp               = true
  transport_tcp_tls           = true
  sip_server                  = "ipv4:10.0.0.1"
  redirection                 = true
  handle_replaces             = true
  reason_header_override      = true
  host_registrar              = true
  max_forwards                = 70
  disable_early_media         = "180"
  retry_invite                = 6
  retry_register              = 6
  retry_rel1xx                = 6
  retry_response              = 6
  retry_keepalive             = 6
  timers_expires              = 180000
  timers_trying               = 500
  timers_connection_aging_tls = 720
  timers_options              = 500
  timers_keepalive_active     = 120
  timers_keepalive_down       = 30
  connection_reuse            = true
  connection_reuse_via_port   = true
}
```

- `connection_reuse` (Boolean) Use listener port for sending requests over UDP
- `connection_reuse_via_port` (Boolean) Send responses to port present in Via header
- `credentials_dhcp_password` (String, Sensitive)
- `credentials_dhcp_password_type` (String) - Choices: `0`, `6`, `7`
- `credentials_dhcp_password_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The write-only value of the attribute.

- `credentials_usernames` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials_usernames))
- `crypto_signaling_default_tls_profile` (String) Associate a tls-profile
- `crypto_signaling_remote_addrs` (Attributes List) Associate an IP network to a trustpoint (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--crypto_signaling_remote_addrs))
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `disable_early_media` (String) Disable early-media cut through
  - Choices: `180`
- `handle_replaces` (Boolean) Handle INVITE with REPLACES header at SIP spi
- `host_registrar` (Boolean) Use sip-ua registrar value in Diversion and Contact header for 3xx messages
- `max_forwards` (Number) Change number of max-forwards for SIP Methods
  - Range: `1`-`70`
- `reason_header_override` (Boolean) Enable Reason header to override SIP<->Q850 Mappings
- `redirection` (Boolean) Enable call redirection (3XX) handling
- `registrar_dhcp` (Boolean) Registrar Server address provision via DHCP
- `registrar_primary` (String)
- `registrar_primary_expires` (Number) Default registration expires time
  - Range: `60`-`65535`
- `registrar_primary_refresh_ratio` (Number) Default registration refresh ratio
  - Range: `1`-`100`
- `registrar_primary_scheme` (String) URL scheme - sips or sip
  - Choices: `sip`, `sips`
- `registrar_primary_tcp` (Boolean) Use TCP as Transport Layer Protocol (default: UDP)
- `registrar_primary_tls` (Boolean) Use TLS encryption over TCP Transport Layer Protocol
- `registrar_secondary` (String)
- `registrar_secondary_expires` (Number) Default registration expires time
  - Range: `60`-`65535`
- `registrars` (Attributes List) Registrar Index Value for configuring multiple registrars (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registrars))
- `remote_party_id` (Boolean) Enable Remote-Party-ID support in SIP User Agent calls
- `retry_invite` (Number) INVITE retry value
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `retry_keepalive` (Number) KEEPALIVE retry value
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `retry_register` (Number) REGISTER retry value
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `retry_rel1xx` (Number) Reliable 1xx retry value
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `retry_response` (Number) Response retry value
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `sip_server` (String) Configure a SIP Server Interface
- `timers_connection_aging_tls` (Number) TCP/UDP aging timer value in minutes
  - Range: `60`-`4320`
- `timers_expires` (Number) Time to wait for the expiration of an INVITE request
  - Range: `60000`-`1800000`
- `timers_keepalive_active` (Number) Time to wait between keepalive messages in active state
  - Range: `10`-`600`
- `timers_keepalive_down` (Number) Time to wait between keepalive messages in down state
  - Range: `1`-`120`
- `timers_options` (Number) Time to wait before OPTIONS retransmission
  - Range: `100`-`1000`
- `timers_trying` (Number) Time to wait for provisional response to INVITE
  - Range: `100`-`1000`
- `transport_tcp` (Boolean) Enable SIP User Agent in TCP Mode
- `transport_tcp_tls` (Boolean) Enable SIP User Agent in TLS over TCP mode (Default: All TLS versions with fallback)
- `transport_udp` (Boolean) Enable SIP User Agent in UDP Mode

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_sip_ua.example ""
```
